tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Quad-Port PCIe x4 Gigabit SFP Ethernet Server Adapter – High-Performance Networking for Data Centers

Optimize Your Enterprise Network with Intel I350 Quad-Port SFP Ethernet Adapter

The Quad-Port PCIe x4 Gigabit SFP Ethernet Server Adapter is an advanced networking solution designed for enterprise servers, data centers, cloud computing, and virtualization environments. Built with the Intel® I350 Ethernet Controller, this high-performance server adapter delivers exceptional reliability, energy efficiency, and scalable networking capabilities.


With support for iSCSI, virtualization, and Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE), this adapter ensures seamless data transfer, reduced power consumption, and improved network efficiency.


Key Features 

  • Quad-Port 1GbE SFP Fiber Connectivity – High-speed, low-latency network performance for enterprise servers and storage systems.
  • Intel® I350 Ethernet Controller – Provides reliable and proven gigabit networking technology for data centers and virtualization.
  • PCI Express 2.1 x4 Interface (5GT/s) – Compatible with x4, x8, and x16 PCIe slots for maximum bandwidth efficiency.
  • Advanced Virtualization Support – Offers port partitioning and Quality of Service (QoS) for up to 32 virtual ports.
  • Scalable iSCSI Performance – Cost-effective SAN connectivity for virtualized and cloud-based infrastructures.
  • Energy-Efficient Networking – Supports Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) and DMA Coalescing (DMAC) to reduce power consumption without compromising performance.
  • Bridgeless Design – Ensures high-speed packet processing and minimal CPU overhead.


Comprehensive OS Compatibility – Supports Windows Server, Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian, SUSE), FreeBSD, and VMware.

Enterprise-Grade Reliability – CE, FCC, and RoHS-certified for mission-critical applications.


Technical Specifications

  • Model: Quad-Port PCIe x4 Gigabit SFP Ethernet Server Adapter
  • Controller: Intel® I350 Ethernet Controller
  • Ports: Quad SFP Gigabit Ethernet
  • Interface: PCI Express 2.1 x4 (5GT/s), supports x4, x8, and x16 slots
  • Bracket: Full-height (low-profile bracket included in the package)
  • Form Factor: PCIe network adapter
  • Dimension: 155 mm x 68 mm

Networking Features

  • Quad 1GbE SFP Ports – Supports various SFP transceivers for flexible connectivity
  • IEEE 802.3 Compliance – Fully compliant with 10BASE-T, 100BASE-TX, 1000BASE-T standards
  • IEEE 1588 & 802.1AS Support – Ensures precise time synchronization for industrial and financial applications
  • Automatic Cross-Over Detection (MDI/MDI-X) – Simplifies cable connections by eliminating the need for crossover cables
  • Flow Control Support (IEEE 802.3x & 802.3z) – Optimizes data flow and reduces network congestion
  • Checksum Offloading & Jumbo Frame Support – Enhances network efficiency and reduces CPU workload
  • Advanced Traffic Management – Supports interrupt throttling, load balancing, and RMON statistics monitoring
  • PXE Boot & iSCSI Remote Boot Support – Facilitates remote server deployment
  • Virtualization & Cloud Optimization
  • Supports VMDq & SR-IOV – Accelerates virtual machine networking and reduces CPU overhead
  • IPv4 & IPv6 Support – Future-proof networking for next-gen infrastructures
  • VXLAN & VLAN Support – Optimized for cloud environments and multi-tenant networks

Manageability & Security

  • PXE Boot, SNMP, RMON Support – Advanced network monitoring and remote management
  • Link & Activity LED Indicators – Visual status for easy troubleshooting
  • NC-SI (Network Controller Sideband Interface) – For seamless remote management
  • Cable Distances & Connectivity
  • 1.25G SFP Compatible – Compatible with various SFP transceivers
  • Fiber Cable Support – Multi-Mode Fiber (MMF) 62.5/50µm
  • Transmission Distance – Depends on SFP module used

Operating System Compatibility

  • Windows Client: Windows 11, 10, 8.1, 8, 7
  • Windows Server: 2008 R2, 2012, 2012 R2, 2016, 2019, 2022
  • Linux: Mikrotik OS, RHEL 7.9 / 8.4 / 8.5, SLES 12 SP5 / 15 SP3, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS / 20.04 LTS, FreeBSD 12.2 / 13
  • VMware: Fully supported for virtualization
  • Power & Environmental Specifications
  • Power Consumption (Typical):
  • Copper (I350T2V2): 4.4W
  • Copper (I350T4V2): 5.0W
  • Fiber (I350F2): 5.5W
  • Fiber (I350F4): 6.0W
  • Airflow Requirement: Minimum 100 LFM
  • Storage Temperature: -40°C to 70°C (-40°F to 158°F)
  • Operating Temperature: 0°C to 55°C (32°F to 131°F)
  • Storage Humidity: Up to 90% non-condensing at 35°C
  • Certifications: CE, FCC, RoHS

Ideal Applications

  • Enterprise Data Centers – Ensures high-speed, reliable networking for mission-critical applications.
  • Cloud & Virtualization Environments – Supports advanced virtualization features such as SR-IOV and VMDq.
  • iSCSI Storage Networks – Provides cost-effective SAN connectivity for virtualized environments.
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC) – Delivers low-latency, high-bandwidth connectivity for data-intensive applications.
  • ISP & Hosting Providers – Ensures scalable and reliable networking solutions.
  • Remote Server Management – NC-SI enables efficient out-of-band server management.


Why Choose the Quad-Port PCIe x4 Gigabit SFP Ethernet Adapter?

  • Intel I350 Ethernet Controller – Reliable, energy-efficient, and optimized for enterprise networking.
  • PCI Express 2.1 (x4) Interface – Maximizes bandwidth and reduces CPU overhead.
  • Quad 1GbE SFP Ports – High-speed connectivity for storage networks, virtualization, and cloud applications.
  • Advanced Virtualization Support – Optimized for cloud-based workloads and virtual machine environments.
  • Energy-Efficient & Reliable – Supports Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) and DMA Coalescing (DMAC).
  • Enterprise-Grade Performance – Certified for data center and high-performance computing applications.
  • Wide OS Compatibility – Supports Windows Server, Linux, VMware, and FreeBSD.
